text:
The multi-device control room to orchestrate teams of 100+ coding agents
 From your phone, desktop and browser. 

 Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and more, working together and in parallel on your own machines.

 Sessions can spawn subagents across agents: e.g. Claude asking Codex for a review, or Codex delegating work to Claude subagents. Switch agents mid-session. Approve, steer, review and commit from wherever you are.

 Open source · Self-hostable · End-to-end encrypted

 Use Grok Bot? Install and manage Happier through Grok on X 

Install the Happier session control Grok Bot on X. On first run it installs the Happier CLI on its own computer, pairs with your Happier Cloud account or self-hosted relay, and starts the daemon. You control how hands-on it is: watch only, assist, or drive sessions. Grok Bot integration

 3. Start a session

 Or in the terminal , from any project folder:

 

Either way, the session shows up everywhere at once: keep typing in the terminal, follow along and approve from your phone, review in the browser. happier --help lists the other agents and commands.

 What you can do

 📱 Run your agents from your phone, desktop or the web 

 Start, steer, review and approve sessions from whichever device is in your hand. Sessions are cross-device, so you pick up the same session wherever you are, including Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode sessions already running on your machine. Continuing a session 

 

 

 🖥️ Orchestrate parallel sessions across machines 

 Run as many sessions as you like and pick the machine, folder, agent and model for each one. Follow all of them from one list, whichever machine they run on. Starting a session · Machines and the daemon 

 

 

 🔄 Switch agents mid-session 

 Move a session from Claude to Codex, or back, in place. The session keeps its id, history and settings, and the arriving agent gets a summary of the recent conversation. Continue with another agent 

 

 

 🔔 An inbox for what needs you 

 Permission requests, agent questions and unread sessions gather in one attention center across all sessions and machines. A push notification opens the exact session that asked. Inbox and approvals 

 

 

 📝 Review diffs and send notes back 

 Browse your agent's changes and mark the exact lines you want addressed. Send the notes straight back to the same session or to a new one. Review comments 

 

 

 🌿 Git and worktrees from any device 

 Stage, commit, push, branch and open pull requests without leaving the app. Start a session in its own Git worktree from any local or remote branch, or in the folder you are already in. Git · New session options 

 

 

 📬 Queue it, steer it 

 Queue messages while the agent works and reorder or edit them before they run. Steer a running turn without interrupting it. Steering · Pending queue 

 

 

 🪪 Subscriptions, account pools and usage limits 

 Connect several accounts you own for the same service and group them in a pool. With automatic switching turned on, a pool moves sessions to another account when one hits a usage limit or its sign-in expires, so the work keeps going. When there is nowhere to switch, Claude sessions resume on their own once the limit resets. Connected services and pools · Usage limits 

 

 

 📊 Track your accounts usage 

 See how much is left on each of your connected accounts and subscriptions. For a Claude subscription that means the 5-hour and weekly limits, with the time until each one resets. Connected services 

 

 

 🤝 Subagents across agents 

 A session can hand work to another agent. Claude can start a review, plan or delegate run on Codex, for example, and you follow every run from the Agents tab in the session. Delegated work 

 

 

 🗂️ Files, editor and terminal 

 Browse, search and edit the files in a session's folder from any device. Open a terminal on the connected machine when you need a quick command. Files and editor · Embedded terminal

install.title: Get started
install.html:
1. Install on your computer

The desktop app is the recommended way in: it sets up the CLI and the daemon for you.



Prefer the terminal? Install the CLI and daemon without the desktop app

macOS/Linux:

curl -fsSL https://happier.dev/install | bash

Windows:

iwr https://happier.dev/install.ps1 -useb | iex

If you specifically want the npm package instead: npm install -g @happier-dev/cli (CLI docs).

Already use Claude Code, Codex or another coding agent? Let it set Happier up with you

Paste this into your agent:

Set up Happier on this computer by following https://docs.happier.dev/getting-started/agent-setup.mdx
Fetch that file raw (for example with curl) and follow it step by step with me.

It asks what it needs to know, confirms each change, and leaves the sign-in approval and your agent's own login to you. Set up with your coding agent

Use Grok Bot? Install and manage Happier through Grok on X

Install the Happier session control Grok Bot on X. On first run it installs the Happier CLI on its own computer, pairs with your Happier Cloud account or self-hosted relay, and starts the daemon. You control how hands-on it is: watch only, assist, or drive sessions. Grok Bot integration

Installing on a remote computer or devbox? Set it up over SSH, from your machine

One command installs the CLI and the daemon on the remote host (release-signature verified) and registers it as one of your machines:

happier machine setup --ssh user@host

To sign the remote machine in without a browser on its side, run this from a machine where you are already signed in:

happier auth pair-remote --ssh user@host

Headless alternative on the remote host itself: happier auth login --no-open --method web prints an authorization URL you approve from any browser. Machines and the daemon

You sign in from the app, or on first run.

2. Add your phone
Direct APK
stable release

Sign in with the same account and your sessions, machines and settings are already there.

3. Start a session

In the app → Press New session, pick the machine, the folder and the agent. No terminal needed.

Or in the terminal, from any project folder:

happier            # Claude Code
happier codex      # Codex
happier opencode   # OpenCode

Either way, the session shows up everywhere at once: keep typing in the terminal, follow along and approve from your phone, review in the browser. happier --help lists the other agents and commands.
